name: Leek

low.description: Green leaves ONLY - not the white part

high.description: White/light green parts are high FODMAP

siboNotes: Like scallions, leeks have a split personality: the GREEN LEAVES are low FODMAP while the WHITE BULB is high FODMAP. During elimination, only use the dark green portions. The white parts should be avoided like onion.
preparationTips: Separate green from white - only use green leaves
Green parts work well in soups and stocks
Discard white and light green portions
Use scallion greens or chives as alternatives
